storyCards.headline: Smile A Little Smile For Me: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
The Flying Machine's "Smile A Little Smile For Me" reached #5 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #5 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 14 weeks on the chart.

Smile A Little Smile For Me was released in 1969.

"Smile A Little Smile For Me" by The Flying Machine.

Chart story — peaked at #5 on the Hot 100.
